articles.summary: FALLS CHURCH, Va., Sept. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Northrop Grumman Corporation (NYSE: NOC) will participate in the 14 th Annual Morgan Stanley Laguna Conference on Thursday, September 17. Kathy Warden, chair, chief executive officer and president, will present beginning at 12:15 p.m.
articles.title: Northrop Grumman to Participate in the 14th Annual Morgan Stanley Laguna Conference
